definitions.explanation: A subway or underground rail system. In Japan, most familiar from {東京|とうきょう}メトロ, the main operator of Tokyo's underground network, but also used for subways in other cities, particularly overseas.

examples.japanese: {東京|とうきょう}メトロ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
⟦パリ→パリ：25088_pari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧メトロ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{切符|きっぷ}→切符：00643_kippu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。
examples.english: The Paris metro has cheap tickets.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧メトロ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{二駅|ふたえき}しか⟦かからない→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It only takes two stops on the metro from the station to my company.

notes:
From French/English 'metro' (short for 'metropolitan railway'). In Japan, more often heard in {東京|とうきょう}メトロ than as a standalone word — for subways generally, ⟦{地下鉄|ちかてつ}→地下鉄：01020_chikatetsu⟧ is the more common term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {東京|とうきょう}メトロ: Tokyo Metro
- メトロ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to take the metro
- メトロ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧: metro station
- メトロ{銀座線|ぎんざせん}: Ginza Line (Tokyo Metro)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{地下鉄|ちかてつ}→地下鉄：01020_chikatetsu⟧: subway; underground (most common Japanese term)
- {都営地下鉄|とえいちかてつ}: Toei Subway (Tokyo's other operator)
